name: First Results from the XENON10 Dark Matter Experiment at the Gran Sasso National Laboratory

summary.plain: After about two months of data, XENON10 found no sign of dark matter and ruled out a range of WIMP strengths not previously excluded.
summary.technical: 58.6 live days (6 Oct 2006 - 14 Feb 2007), 5.4 kg fiducial mass, blind analysis, nuclear-recoil energy down to 4.5 keV. 90% CL spin-independent WIMP-nucleon limits of 8.8e-44 cm^2 (100 GeV/c^2) and 4.5e-44 cm^2 (30 GeV/c^2).

title: First Results from the XENON10 Dark Matter Experiment at the Gran Sasso National Laboratory
why_it_matters: It was the first science result of the XENON programme and the paper reports it as excluding previously unexplored parameter space.
